name: Dev Console help
description: Help mode entries for the Dev Console: every screen, the banners, approvals (Approve / Deny / details / Watch live), Builds + Steps, the orchestrator, build profiles, UI Review + Screenshots, the Breakroom (agent swarm + HR), keys, systems check, push banner, Plan Studio, plus screen intros. Hand-written; plugin drafts live in each plugin's help.json.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Home
entries.text: The console's front page: how the framework is doing, what's building, what needs you. Start here when you're lost.
entries.tryIt: Tap any card to jump to its screen.

entries.title: Tracker
entries.text: Every framework feature and where it's at: built, partial, planned. Green means done, kid.

entries.title: Plan
entries.text: The build plan: what gets built, in what order, and what's done.

entries.title: Build queue
entries.text: The queue of build steps waiting their turn. The MCP tools build_next and build_step work through it.

entries.title: Pending builds
entries.text: Builds parked until you say go (or until their model is around). 'Add it to the pending list' means it lands here, not built.

entries.title: Projects
entries.text: Every project's manifest. Nothing gets loaded or built without a valid one.

entries.title: Manifest rules
entries.text: The rules every project manifest is checked against. Locked rules can't be loosened.

entries.title: Catalog
entries.text: Every feature the framework has or plans, with its status.

entries.title: Libraries
entries.text: Installable libraries for apps on the framework (settings, alerts, hub…).

entries.title: Demos
entries.text: Demo apps showing the framework off.

entries.title: Modules
entries.text: The Android modules (on hold for now).

entries.title: Boilerplates
entries.text: Starting points for new apps.

entries.title: Components
entries.text: Every framework control, live, in the current theme. Handy to see what a swap does.

entries.title: Assets
entries.text: Every asset in the app (themes, layouts, menus…). Pick one, look at its JSON, activate it live.

entries.title: Account
entries.text: Your role and what it lets you do. Switch roles to see the console as someone else.

entries.title: Builds
entries.text: Every build of the active profile in one place. Builds view: one row per build with a live progress bar. Steps view: every step on its own row.
entries.more: This is the one builds store (builds@1). Everything else — Pending builds, the build queue, the Build manager — is just a view of it, so they can't drift apart. Changes are drafts until you tap Apply; Discard throws them away. Every save is versioned, so Restore default or the history can always get you back.
entries.tryIt: Double-tap a build's name to rename it.

entries.title: Build orchestrator
entries.text: Breaks every build into steps of 30 minutes or less, each pinned to Fable or Opus. When the model switches between phases it waits for your OK.
entries.more: Tabs: Builds (like Pending builds, with more options), Approvals (phases waiting for your OK at a model switch) and Rules (the token rules: one session, no sub-agents, briefs carry only the current phase).

entries.title: Build manager
entries.text: Everything building right now and everything left: model, status, time left, steps. Start a build from here and watch it live.

entries.title: Build Breaker
entries.text: Everything you ever asked for, in plain English, with what happened to each ask.

entries.title: Feature matrix
entries.text: Each build's list of pieces with minutes, model and why. Tick = keep, untick = skip, then Apply.

entries.title: UI Review
entries.text: Every new screen, dialog, menu or banner a build makes waits here for your OK, with phone and desktop shots. Approve, ask for changes or reject.
entries.more: A PR whose UI is waiting, has changes asked or is rejected is held: it won't merge until you approve it here. Screenshots that aren't for approval go to Screenshots instead.
entries.tryIt: Open one and swipe between the phone and desktop shots.

entries.title: Screenshots
entries.text: Pictures Claude took while checking things — not for approval. Every shot sits in a named, timestamped group.
entries.tryIt: Open a group, then Send to review if one should be approved after all.

entries.title: Design packs
entries.text: Whole matched looks waiting for review.

entries.title: Agent swarm (the Breakroom)
entries.text: Your crew of specialist agents: who's working, on what, what it's costing, and their ID cards. The HR side lets you hire, suspend, rehire and top them up.
entries.more: Swarm shows the jobs a build was split into and which agent holds which files. Crew is the roster with statuses and salaries. Cards are the ID-card designs. Cost shows runs, tokens and dollars per agent — today, this week and all time. Group chat is where they talk.
entries.tryIt: Open Crew and tap an agent to see its card.

entries.title: Agent manager
entries.text: Your named agents (Molly and friends): who they are, what they know, what they may do.

entries.title: AI assistant
entries.text: Ask Claude about the console, the framework or your builds.

entries.title: Plan Studio
entries.text: Every plan in one place. 'Put it in a plan for later' lands here, parked — it only becomes a build when you say Turn into a build.
entries.tryIt: Switch between Tree, Grid, Board and Roadmap at the top.

entries.title: Plugin Manager
entries.text: Every plugin: what it does, its switch, logs, settings and what it needs. Turn one off and it's gone from every screen.
entries.tryIt: Tap a plugin, then its Settings.

entries.title: Plugin Update
entries.text: New versions of your plugins, and replacing one built by another model.

entries.title: New project
entries.text: Make a new project: an AXF app, a GitHub repo or a folder, with its manifest and Claude files.

entries.title: Sessions

entries.text: Pulls the audio out of a video.

entries.title: Brand library
entries.text: Logos, animated marks and icon packs for your apps.

entries.title: Context menu designer

entries.title: Approvals banner
entries.text: Shows up whenever axHub is holding a call on its 90-second countdown, or waiting on you. It runs by itself when the countdown ends unless you Deny it.
entries.more: Deny = it never runs. Approve = run it now. Shelve = pause the countdown until you decide. The banner rings (Settings → Plugins → Approvals banner) so you don't miss one.
entries.tryIt: Tap a row to open the full call.

entries.title: Build manager banner
entries.text: What's building right now, with progress and time left. Tap it for the Build manager.

entries.title: Codebase changes banner
entries.text: Every change Claude made that you haven't closed yet. Closing one clears it on every device; it stays in the log.

entries.title: Keys needed
entries.text: A key or token is missing or dead. Tap Fix for the exact steps.

entries.title: Push banner
entries.text: Every branch not on main yet, with its PR and CI. Ready PRs merge by themselves; you don't have to do a thing.

entries.title: Systems check
entries.text: Something's broken: what broke, what it breaks and since when, with a Fix button. Green means you're good.

steps.say: This is the console's front page. The cards show how the framework's doing and what needs you.
The banners up top are live: approvals waiting, builds running, anything broken. Tap one to deal with it.
Everything is also in the app menu at the top, even when the nav is hidden. The ? next to it turns this help on and off.
Every build of the active profile, one row each, with a live progress bar and the time left.
Switch to Steps to see every step on its own row — expand, select, divide or move them.
Your edits are a draft until you hit Apply. Discard throws them away; every save can be restored.
Every build gets broken into steps of 30 minutes or less, each pinned to Fable or Opus.
When the model switches between phases, it stops and asks you. That's the only time it asks.
Rules shows the token rules every session follows: one session, no sub-agents, short briefs.
Builds parked until you say go. Each step shows [Fable] or [Opus].
It's a view of the one builds store, so it always matches the Builds page and the orchestrator.
What's building right now and what's left, with model, status and time left.
Watch live on a running build pops up the screen it's changing, hot-rendering.
Every new screen, dialog or banner a build makes waits here for your OK, with phone and desktop shots.
Approve, Ask for changes or Reject. A PR stays held until its UI is approved.
Plain screenshots that don't need approval live next door in Screenshots.
Pictures Claude took while checking things, each in a named, timestamped group.
Open a group to swipe through it; Send to review moves one into the approval queue.
Your crew of specialist agents. Swarm shows the jobs and who holds which files.
Crew is the roster: status, skills, salary. Suspend, Rehire and Top up are the HR buttons.
Cards are their ID cards — pick a design and Make default.
Cost shows what each agent spent today, this week and all time.
Every plan in one place. 'Put it in a plan for later' lands here, parked.
Switch views at the top: Tree, Grid, Board, Roadmap, Reader.
A plan only becomes a build when you hit Turn into a build.
Every plugin with what it does, its switch, logs and settings.
Turn one off and it's gone from every screen. Each one can be uninstalled completely.
Every framework feature and where it's at: built, partial or planned.
It's generated from the catalog and status files, so it never lies about what's done.
The build plan: what gets built and in what order.
Tap a feature to see its steps and what it depends on.
